name: design-consensus
title: Design Consensus
summary: Multi-model convergence workflow that produces a design document as its terminal artifact. Multiple providers draft independently, then converge through structured critique rounds until consensus is reached. No implementation — stops after writing the canonical design doc.
when_to_use: When you need a high-quality design document that benefits from multiple model perspectives
When architectural decisions require cross-validation across different reasoning styles
When you want a converged design doc before committing to implementation

inputs.name: providers
inputs.description: Comma-separated provider IDs to participate in consensus. Defaults to all providers with Design capability.

inputs.name: turns
inputs.description: Maximum convergence turns before forcing materialization. Defaults to coordination config value.

steps: SurveyWorkspace: Gather repository context, file structure, and existing design artifacts
DraftDesignDoc (one per provider): Each provider independently drafts a design document section
ConvergenceRound (iterated): Providers critique and refine drafts until consensus criteria are met
MaterializeDesignDoc: Aggregate converged drafts into a single canonical design document
outputs: Per-provider draft artifacts for audit trail
Convergence metadata showing rounds and consensus metrics
